description: Verifies the ability of a user to log in using the Google OAuth option from the login page.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Verify the presence of the Google OAuth login option.
Click on the Google OAuth login link.
Wait for the Google login page to load.
Enter valid Google account credentials (email and password).
Submit the login form on the Google page.
Verify that the user is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Verify the presence of a session token indicating successful login.
Confirm that the user is redirected to the primary application dashboard at https://dev.roost.ai.
expected_results: User should be redirected to the Google login page.
User should successfully log in with valid credentials.
User should be redirected back to the application dashboard.
A session token should be generated.
edge_cases: Invalid Google credentials result in an error message.
Network failure during redirection interrupts the login process.
Google OAuth API returns an unexpected response.
User's Google account is locked or disabled.
Session token is not generated upon successful login.
data_requirements: Access to the Google OAuth API.
Valid client ID and redirect URI for integration.
User account in Roost platform linked to Google.
dependencies: Valid client ID is registered with Google.
User has an existing Google account.
Roost platform supports Google OAuth integration.
api_interactions: Roost backend API for session token generation.
Redirection mechanism handling between Google and Roost.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the Google OAuth login page.
Time taken for redirection back to Roost after login.
accessibility_requirements: Google login page must be accessible for screen readers.
Ensure the Google OAuth login link has appropriate ARIA labels.
Verify keyboard navigation for the login link.
